classes.label: Database
classes.description: An organized collection of structured data that is stored and accessed electronically using a database management system

classes.label: Relational Database
classes.description: A database that organizes data into tables with rows and columns, following the relational model of data

classes.label: SQL
classes.description: Structured Query Language, a standardized language used to query, retrieve, and manipulate data in relational databases

classes.label: Database Management System
classes.description: Software system that manages the storage, retrieval, and update of data in a database

classes.label: Index
classes.description: A data structure that improves the speed of data retrieval operations on a table by creating a sorted lookup mechanism

classes.label: Query
classes.description: A request for data retrieval or manipulation from a database, typically expressed in SQL

classes.label: Execution Plan
classes.description: A detailed plan generated by the query optimizer that outlines how the database will execute a query

classes.label: Query Optimizer
classes.description: A component of the database management system that determines the most efficient way to execute a query

classes.label: Data Integrity
classes.description: The accuracy, consistency, and reliability of data throughout its lifecycle in a database

classes.label: Constraint
classes.description: A rule enforced by the database to maintain data quality, consistency, and validity

classes.label: Primary Key
classes.description: A constraint that uniquely identifies each row in a table

classes.label: Foreign Key
classes.description: A constraint that establishes a relationship between tables and maintains referential integrity

classes.label: Unique Constraint
classes.description: A constraint that prevents duplicate values in specified columns

classes.label: Check Constraint
classes.description: A constraint that validates that column values meet specific conditions

classes.label: Referential Integrity
classes.description: A property that ensures relationships between tables remain consistent and valid

properties.label: uses
properties.description: Indicates that one entity uses or employs another

properties.label: is_a
properties.description: Indicates that one entity is a type of another

properties.label: part_of
properties.description: Indicates that one entity is a component of another

properties.label: improves
properties.description: Indicates that one entity enhances or optimizes another

properties.label: maintains
properties.description: Indicates that one entity preserves or upholds another

properties.label: enforces
properties.description: Indicates that one entity implements or applies another
